findings.detail: the chain says the RAB40AL ligase lowers ISCA1 and ISCA1 is required for Fe-S assembly, so losing RAB40AL should raise ISCA1 and Fe-S clusters and protect; the arm composes RAB40AL ->+ ALS, while the mechanism claims loss of RAB40AL makes Fe-S activity fall (hidden behind 'ISCA1 is mis-set'); the falsification's expected 'negative' ISCA1 on overexpression agrees with H2.2, not with the claim; because all three hypotheses claim RAB40AL ->- ALS, this one route is the only arm for H1 and H3 as well, so the run's own statements, composed, contradict all three claimed directions

H1's own chain has no route from RAB40AL to ALS: H1.2 ends at ubiquitin-dependent turnover, H1.3 starts at 'accumulated regulators' (a different, unidentified node, unsigned by the run's own note); the arm render.py finds is H2's route S7-S11, borrowed, and its sign differs from H1's claim

H3's own chain has no route from RAB40AL to ALS: its only RAB40AL steps are a compartment association and 'binds FYCO1', and 'GTP-RAB40AL contributes to FYCO1 recruitment' is never a signed step; the arm render.py finds is H2's route S7-S11, borrowed, and its sign differs from H3's claim
H1.1 ends at CUL5, H1.2 starts at the ECS(RAB40AL) ligase; the curator merged the ligase into RAB40AL
H2.1 ends at ISCA1 and H2.2 also ends at ISCA1 (starting at the ligase): two parallel edges RAB40AL to ISCA1, not a chain
H2.3 ends at '[4Fe-4S] cluster assembly', H2.4 starts at 'Fe-S cluster deficiency' (a process vs its product); joined only by the GO:0044572 definition bridge S9
H3.4 ends at clearance of p62/TDP-43; H3.5 starts at 'stalled autophagosomes', which is H3.3's transport node inverted, so H3.4 is a dead-end branch
8 of 15 steps cite nothing, and the notes say so ('not in the ledger', 'textbook', 'from the literature'); every step into ALS is uncited

eight STRING enrichment terms are used as 'receipts'; four of them (GO:0031466, GO:0043161, GO:0120184, GO:0150118) do not even include RAB40AL among their input genes, so they describe the paralogues' neighbourhood

the ChEMBL record gives only a phase 4 ALS indication for CHEMBL290916; 'edaravone, a radical scavenger' is the agent's knowledge, and an approved drug does not show that Fe-S deficiency causes oxidative stress
H2.2 (the ligase degrades ISCA1) cites a protein-ubiquitination enrichment and the RAB40AL-CUL5 edge; its own note concedes 'Not shown for any RAB40 member'
paralogue edges (RAB40A-ISCA1, ISCA1-RAB40B) are cited as corroborating RAB40AL, and H1's substrates are inferred from RAB40B/C; separate proteins, excluded as not_this_entity
H3.1 cites UniProt for an endosome / synaptic-vesicle association, but UniProt locates RAB40AL to membrane, cytoplasm and mitochondrion; the compartment claim rests on neighbourhood enrichments only

all three chains assume RAB40AL acts in motor neurons, but no step states its expression there; HPA (not detected) and CELLxGENE (no transcript) bear on that premise, so they refute nothing in the chains; the falsification admits 'every source says the gene is off in the CNS'

all three hypotheses carry support 'grounded' though most steps cite nothing and the kept evidence is two binding edges, a localisation and a by-similarity UniProt line; confidence 'low' is fair, 'grounded' is not

the CELLxGENE 'not detected' record is uninformative: at the normal rate (0.024%) about 1.5 of 6,442 ALS OPCs would be expected positive, so zero has probability about 0.21 by chance; and the cells are OPCs, not motor neurons

the mouse Rab40b knockout (decreased MCHC) is listed as contradicting H2, yet the falsification calls it 'the one thin hint that the family touches iron biology'; MCHC is a red-cell index, not Fe-S cluster biology
the AGR record calls mouse Rab40b the orthologue of human RAB40AL; by name it is RAB40B's orthologue, so the mapping may be family-level; worth checking before using it as RAB40AL evidence

two supporting citations sit at no step: STRING:GO:0001953 (an enrichment without RAB40AL) and OT:RAB40AL-tractability, which repeats the UniProt function text and records 0 associated diseases, which is closer to contradicting than supporting
the mechanism's 'X-linkage would make the effect hemizygous in men, who carry the excess ALS risk' is neither a step nor cited
only RAB40AL (as UniProtKB:P0C0E4) and ALS (MONDO:0004976) carry CURIEs; every other node, including CUL5, ISCA1 and FYCO1, has an empty curie
